purpose: Aggregate independent decision judgments while preserving disagreement and hard-policy precedence.
rules: Hard policy result is evaluated before judge aggregation.
Judges must be independent enough that one output is not copied as another judge's evidence.
If HIGH or CRITICAL risk judges disagree on selected outcome, return ESCALATE.
If LOW or MEDIUM risk judges disagree, return REVIEW unless an explicit evaluated policy says otherwise.
If all judges select the same outcome, probabilities may be averaged and confidence_basis becomes MULTI_JUDGE.
Missing judge evidence never counts as agreement.
